newsitem.title: FRANCE: EUROPEAN UNEMPLOYED PLAN MARCH ON APRIL 14.
newsitem.headline: EUROPEAN UNEMPLOYED PLAN MARCH ON APRIL 14.

text.p: Unemployed from across Europe plan to set out on April 14 on a march to Amsterdam to vent their anger at rising joblessness, organisers said on Tuesday.

They said they hoped some 30,000 jobless would join the march, which is expected to reach Amsterdam on June 14 to coincide with the final session of the European Union's Inter-Governmental Conference (IGC) on EU reform.
The march is being modeled after a similar one on Sunday in which tens of thousands of European trade unionists and politicians converged on Brussels to express their anger at rising unemployment.
It followed French carmaker Renault's shock decision two weeks ago to close its profitable Vilvoorde plant with the loss of 3,100 jobs.
